newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot Q1 comparable store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot Q1 comparable store sales rise.

text.p: Home Depot Inc said Tuesday that that comparable store sales for the first quarter ended May 4 rose 11 percent from the previous year.
The home improvement retailer said that annualized inventory turnover improved to 5.5 through the first quarter of fiscal 1997 from 5.3 through the first quarter of fiscal 1996.
Home Depot reported first quarter earnings of $0.53 a share on sales of $5.66 billion, copmpared with $0.41 a share on sales of $43.6 billion the previous first quarter.

"We are particularly pleased with strong sales trends in the first quarter, which reflect an earlier start to the spring season versus last year," said Bernard Marcus, chairman and chief executive officer in a press release.
During the first quarter of fiscal 1997, Home Depot opened 24 new stores and relocated one store.

At the end of the quarter, the company operated a total of 536 stores, including 503 Home Depot stores and five EXPO Design Centers in the U.S. and 28 Home Depot stores in Canada, with an aggregate of about 57 million square feet of selling space.
